sentences.text: Aba/1241/2025 on 5 December, 2025

Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
Sl. Office Notes,
No. Date reports,
 orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order
S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  ABA No. 1241 of 2025  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Gaurav Kandpal, learned counsel with Mr. Varun Agarwal, learned counsel (through V.C.) for the applicant.
2. Mr. Himanshu Sain, learned Brief Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Ajay Joshi, learned counsel for the complainant.

4. The instant anticipatory bail application has been moved by the applicant Smt. Uma Krishna,
W/o Atul Krishna praying for anticipatory bail in reference to FIR dated 29.09.2025, bearing FIR No. 0083 of 2025 registered at P.S. Rani Pokhari District Dehradun wherein the present applicant has been implicated for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC read with Section 120B IPC.

5. The matter was listed yesterday and the concerned I.O. joined the proceeding through V.C. and today in order to assist the Court he again joined the proceeding through V.C. and supplied written instructions to Mr. Sain,
learned Brief Holder for the State.
6. I perused the written instructions.

The concerned I.O. apprise to this Court that power of attorney executed in favour of Mr. Shobhit Bhatia by Tarsem Singh, is, in fact, forged power of attorney,
since, the person who has executed the power of attorney in favour of Shobit Bhatia is not Tarsem Singh rather he is one Vipin Panwar who is working as a helper with Ajay Khanna and Vijay Khanna who are also named in the FIR.

He also apprise that in the investigation it has also come to their knowledge that Tarsem Singh is still alive who is being represented by Mr. Ajay Joshi, learned counsel and the person who executed power of attorney in favour of Shobhit Bhatia on 03.01.2008 is Vipin Panwar projected himself as Tarsem Singh, who was identified by the present applicant Smt. Uma Krishna.

The concerned I.O. also apprise to this Court that during investigation photograph of power of attorney holder has been shown to his mother and wife and they stated that ABA/1241/2025 on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144257831/
1 the photograph of the power of attorney holder in the power of attorney dated 03.01.2008 is infact Vipin Panwar.

He also apprise to this Court that on the basis of forged power of attorney dated 03.01.2008, subsequent sale deeds were executed by Vipin Panwar by projecting himself as Tarsem Singh since power of attorney dated 03.01.2008 executed in favour of Shobhit Bhatia is only for the purchase of the land and not for sale.
7. The present applicant, on the direction of this Court, appeared before the I.O. and learned counsel undertakes that she will cooperate with the investigation.

8. Since investigation is still going on and other persons who are named in the FIR got interim protection in WPCRL No. 310 of 2025 and WPCRL No. 1216 of 2025, therefore this Court is of the view that the applicant is also deserves for some interim protection.
9. Let learned counsel for State as well as Mr. Ajay Joshi, learned counsel who put appearance on behalf of the informant Tarsem Singh may file counter affidavit positively within one week.
Three days thereafter is granted to the applicant to file rejoinder affidavit.
11. Put up this matter on 23.12.2025.

(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 05.12.2025 Parul ABA/1241/2025 on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144257831/

opennyai_summary.arguments: 9. Let learned counsel for State as well as Mr. Ajay Joshi, learned counsel who put appearance on behalf of the informant Tarsem Singh may file counter affidavit positively within one week.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Three days thereafter is granted to the applicant to file rejoinder affidavit.
10. Having heard the arguments of learned counsel for the parties, and taking into consideration that other co- accused got interim protection by the coordinate Bench, for an interim measure, this Court is of the view that the applicant deserves for interim protection, and, as such, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, in an event of arrest during investigation, the applicant shall be released on interim anticipatory bail subject to furnishing of personal bond with two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the arresting Officer subject to the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall cooperate with the investigation;
(ii) The applicant shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever.
11. Put up this matter on 23.12.2025.
